headline: Proofreader
summary: English graduate looking for a proofreading role in publishing or education. I proofread student theses and a university journal as a student assistant, check work against APA and in-house style guides, and write short feature articles. I have a sharp eye for grammar and consistency.

Checked every citation and reference list against APA 7th edition.

projects.name: Thesis proofreading service

projects.name: Campus feature stories

experience.title: Student Assistant, Research Office
